Final survivor.method: Fit the orthographic camera matrix from all visible recorded joint world/screen pairs at each frame. Project world displacement over a physics step into that camera and divide by the screen-projected nominal body height (1.50 m forester; 1.75 m hero). Count strides above 95% observed speed. Orientation of motion relative to the camera affects these numbers.
